verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a self-hosted AI runtime with chat history, agents and multi-user accounts, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature for user data in open formats. OpenAI-compatible APIs, open model formats and self-hosting are adjacent openness traits, not a documented export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
